screenshots.caption: YOU PLAY EVERY PLAYER
screenshots.alt: A goal on a felt pitch with confetti, and the runs of three earlier players drawn in chalk

screenshots.caption: FIRST, PLAY THE PASS
screenshots.alt: The first player aims a pass with the aim line showing and the pass button held down

screenshots.caption: REWIND. NOW RUN ONTO IT
screenshots.alt: A second player runs onto the pass while the first player replays his recorded part

screenshots.caption: DEFENDERS REACT TO EVERY RUN
screenshots.alt: A full-back has followed the winger inside, leaving the touchline free for the overlapping runner

screenshots.caption: A DECOY NEVER TOUCHES THE BALL
screenshots.alt: A decoy runner pulls his marker away while the recorded pass travels through the gap

screenshots.caption: MIND YOUR OWN OFFSIDE LINE
screenshots.alt: The offside line across the pitch while the striker waits for a pass from his own earlier player

screenshots.caption: WATCH THE WHOLE MOVE BACK
screenshots.alt: Result sheet with three stars, the move time and the number of takes, over the action replay

screenshots.caption: THREE STARS FOR A QUICK MOVE
screenshots.alt: Fixture list of ticket stubs with stars earned, the next fixture flagged and later ones locked
